# noru-grc-engineering

> Last-mile GRC engineering plugins for Claude Code and Codex: AI inventory, privacy data maps, infrastructure checks and change control, recorded in Noru.

Each piece runs the same three commands: `/<piece>:scan` collects locally into a committed, reviewable `.noru/<piece>.yml`; `/<piece>:diff` shows what would change in Noru and writes nothing; `/<piece>:push` lands it once, idempotently, after explicit confirmation. Noru holds the record; there is no second register in the repository. Runtime code is Node built-ins and the Python 3 standard library, with no network during scan or validation. The plugins never handle a credential: authentication belongs to the MCP host connecting to `https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp`. MIT licensed.

Install from one marketplace, then add the pieces you want (`<piece>@noru-grc-engineering`):

Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering
/plugin install noru@noru-grc-engineering
/plugin install ai-inventory@noru-grc-engineering
```

Codex:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering
codex plugin add noru@noru-grc-engineering
codex plugin add ai-inventory@noru-grc-engineering
```

GitHub Copilot CLI:

```bash
copilot plugin marketplace add noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering
copilot plugin install noru@noru-grc-engineering
copilot plugin install ai-inventory@noru-grc-engineering
```

Pieces: `ai-inventory`, `evidence-push`, `governance-records`, `review-signoff`, `audit-pack`, `iac-scan`, `privacy-datamap`, `change-control`; the hub `noru`; the optional `repo-enforcement` utility; and `compliance-assistant`, listed from its own repository.

Three GitHub Actions run the offline checks with no credential, so they work on a pull request from a fork. `@v0` follows the newest 0.x release:

```yaml
- uses: noru-tech/noru-review-action@v0   # route a pull request diff to the affected pieces; read-only
- uses: noru-tech/noru-ci-action@v0       # one piece: scan, validate, expiry, privacy policy; fails on drift
- uses: noru-tech/noru-enforce-action@v0  # whole-repository merge gate with a ratchet baseline
```

CI exit codes: `0` pass, `1` more than one failure condition, `2` usage, `3` manifest drift, `4` expired interpretation, `5` invalid manifest, `6` a check could not run, `7` personal data the privacy baseline does not permit.

## CI and enforcement

- [CI mode](https://github.com/noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering/blob/main/docs/ci-mode.md): drift, expiry and privacy-baseline gates, exit codes, warn-only adoption, GitLab and shell recipes
- [Findings](https://github.com/noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering/blob/main/docs/findings/README.md): one page per finding kind, with the rule, examples, and how to fix it or record a disposition
- [Repository enforcement](https://github.com/noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering/blob/main/docs/repository-enforcement.md): the merge gate, ratchet baseline, CODEOWNERS and GitHub ruleset
- [noru-ci action](https://github.com/noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering/blob/main/.github/actions/noru-ci/README.md): inputs and outputs
- [noru-review action](https://github.com/noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering/blob/main/.github/actions/noru-review/README.md): inputs and outputs
- [enforce action](https://github.com/noru-tech/noru-grc-engineering/blob/main/actions/enforce/README.md): inputs and outputs
